note: Daily runs take the first lesson whose day is not in state/history.json. Edit freely; keep order beginner -> advanced.

lessons.title: What is Rust & why learn it
lessons.points: fast like C/C++, memory safe without a GC, great tooling (cargo), used by big companies

lessons.title: Install Rust & Hello, World!
lessons.points: rustup installs rustc+cargo; fn main; println! macro; rustc main.rs

lessons.title: Cargo: your Rust toolbox
lessons.points: cargo new, cargo build, cargo run, Cargo.toml, cargo check

lessons.title: Variables & mutability
lessons.points: let is immutable by default; let mut; cannot assign twice error

lessons.title: Constants & shadowing
lessons.points: const needs a type and is always immutable; shadowing with let x = x + 1 creates a new variable

lessons.title: Scalar types
lessons.points: i32 default integer, u8..u128/i8..i128, f64 default float, bool, char is 4 bytes Unicode

lessons.title: Tuples & arrays
lessons.points: tuple (i32, f64, char) destructuring and .0; array [i32; 5] fixed size, index out of bounds panics

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.points: fn name(param: Type) -> Ret; snake_case; parameters need types

lessons.title: Statements vs expressions
lessons.points: blocks are expressions; last expression without ; is the return value

lessons.title: if / else
lessons.points: condition must be bool; if is an expression: let x = if c { 5 } else { 6 };

lessons.title: Loops: loop, while, for
lessons.points: loop with break value; while; for x in collection; for i in 0..5 ranges

lessons.title: Ownership: the 3 rules
lessons.points: each value has one owner; one owner at a time; dropped when owner goes out of scope

lessons.title: Stack vs heap
lessons.points: fixed-size data on the stack; String data on the heap; pointer, length, capacity

lessons.title: Move vs Copy
lessons.points: let s2 = s1 moves a String; integers are Copy; .clone() for deep copy

lessons.title: References & borrowing
lessons.points: &s borrows without taking ownership; function takes &String; owner stays valid

lessons.title: Mutable references
lessons.points: &mut s; only one mutable reference at a time; no mixing & and &mut; prevents data races

lessons.title: Slices
lessons.points: &s[0..5] string slices; &str; array slices &a[1..3]

lessons.title: Structs
lessons.points: struct User { name: String, age: u32 }; field init shorthand; update syntax ..

lessons.title: Methods with impl
lessons.points: impl Rect { fn area(&self) -> u32 }; associated functions like Rect::new

lessons.title: Enums
lessons.points: enum IpAddr { V4(u8,u8,u8,u8), V6(String) }; variants can hold data

lessons.title: Option: no more null
lessons.points: Option<T> is Some(T) or None; the compiler makes you handle None

lessons.title: match
lessons.points: match must be exhaustive; arms with patterns; _ catch-all

lessons.title: if let & let else
lessons.points: if let Some(x) = opt; let Some(x) = opt else { return };

lessons.title: Packages, crates & modules
lessons.points: mod, pub, use; crate root; files map to modules

lessons.title: Vec<T>
lessons.points: Vec::new, vec![1,2,3], push, get returns Option, indexing can panic

lessons.title: String vs &str
lessons.points: String is owned and growable; &str is a borrowed slice; push_str, format!

lessons.title: HashMap
lessons.points: use std::collections::HashMap; insert, get, entry().or_insert() for counting

lessons.title: panic! vs Result
lessons.points: unrecoverable panic!; recoverable Result<T, E>; Ok and Err

lessons.title: The ? operator
lessons.points: propagates errors early; works in functions returning Result or Option

lessons.title: unwrap & expect: when to use
lessons.points: unwrap panics on Err/None; expect adds a message; fine in tests/prototypes

lessons.title: Generics
lessons.points: fn largest<T: PartialOrd>(list: &[T]) -> &T; generic structs Point<T>; zero-cost via monomorphization

lessons.title: Traits
lessons.points: trait Summary { fn summarize(&self) -> String; } impl for types; default methods

lessons.title: Trait bounds & impl Trait
lessons.points: fn notify(item: &impl Summary); where clauses; returning impl Trait

lessons.title: Derive: Debug, Clone, PartialEq
lessons.points: #[derive(Debug)] and {:?}; derive Clone, PartialEq

lessons.title: Lifetimes explained
lessons.points: 'a ties reference lifetimes; fn longest<'a>(x: &'a str, y: &'a str) -> &'a str; prevents dangling references

lessons.title: Writing tests
lessons.points: #[test], assert_eq!, cargo test, #[cfg(test)] mod tests

lessons.title: Closures
lessons.points: |x| x + 1; capture environment; Fn, FnMut, FnOnce; move closures

lessons.title: Iterators
lessons.points: iter(), map, filter, collect, sum; lazy until consumed

lessons.title: Iterator power moves
lessons.points: enumerate, zip, take, skip, fold, chain

lessons.title: Box<T>
lessons.points: heap allocation; recursive types like enum List { Cons(i32, Box<List>), Nil }

lessons.title: Rc<T>: shared ownership
lessons.points: Rc::new, Rc::clone, strong_count; single-threaded only

lessons.title: RefCell & interior mutability
lessons.points: borrow and borrow_mut checked at runtime; panics on violation; Rc<RefCell<T>>

lessons.title: Drop trait
lessons.points: drop runs when a value goes out of scope; RAII; std::mem::drop

lessons.title: Threads
lessons.points: std::thread::spawn, join handles, move closures into threads

lessons.title: Channels
lessons.points: mpsc::channel, tx.send, rx.recv; multiple producers

lessons.title: Arc & Mutex
lessons.points: Arc for shared ownership across threads; Mutex lock; Arc<Mutex<T>> counter

lessons.title: Send & Sync
lessons.points: marker traits; Rc is not Send; the compiler prevents data races

lessons.title: Trait objects: dyn Trait
lessons.points: Vec<Box<dyn Draw>>; dynamic dispatch vs generics

lessons.title: Pattern matching deep dive
lessons.points: destructuring structs and tuples, ranges 1..=5, guards if x > 5, @ bindings

lessons.title: Unsafe Rust
lessons.points: unsafe blocks: raw pointers, unsafe fns, FFI; you uphold the guarantees

lessons.title: Declarative macros
lessons.points: macro_rules!; how vec! works; repetition $( ),*

lessons.title: Async/await basics
lessons.points: async fn returns a Future; .await; needs a runtime like tokio

lessons.title: Tokio: async runtime
lessons.points: #[tokio::main], tokio::spawn, many tasks on few threads

lessons.title: Error handling with anyhow & thiserror
lessons.points: thiserror for library error enums, anyhow for apps, context()

lessons.title: Serde: JSON in Rust
lessons.points: #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]; serde_json::to_string / from_str

lessons.title: Build a CLI with clap
lessons.points: #[derive(Parser)] struct Args; cargo run -- --name x

lessons.title: A web server with axum
lessons.points: Router::new().route("/", get(handler)); tokio::net::TcpListener

lessons.title: Smart pointer cheat sheet
lessons.points: Box vs Rc vs Arc vs RefCell vs Mutex: when to use which

lessons.title: Performance tips
lessons.points: --release builds, avoid needless clone, iterators are zero-cost, measure with cargo bench/criterion

lessons.title: What to build next
lessons.points: project ideas: CLI tool, web API, game with Bevy, contribute to open source
